blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَا تُؤْذُوا الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَلَا تُعَيِّرُوْهُمْ، وَلَا تَطْلُبُوْا عَثَرَاتِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو جزء من الحديث) رواه ابن حبان (واسناده قوي): ٧٥/١٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Do not harm Muslims; do not find fault with them; do not go searching for their mistakes.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ بَرْزَةَ اْلاَسْلَمِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: يَا مَعْشَرَ مَنْ آمَنَ بِلِسَانِهِ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلِ اْلاِيْمَانُ قَلْبَهُ: لَا تَغْتَابُوا الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوْا عَوْرَاتِهِمْ، فَاِنَّهُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ عَوْرَاتِهِمْ يَتَّبِعِ اللهُ عَوْرَتَهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَّبِعِ اللهُ عَوْرَتَهُ يَفْضَحْهُ فِيْ بَيْتِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في الغيبة، رقم:٤٨٨٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “O you who have become Muslim only with the tongue! O people into whose hearts Iman has not entered! Do not backbite Muslims! Do not go searching for their faults! For whoever goes searching for their faults, Allah Ta'ala pursues his faults. And whoever's faults Allah Ta'ala begins to pursue, He will disgrace him even while he stays in his own house.” Hazrat Abu Barzah Aslami (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- “Backbiting about Muslims can only be the work of hypocrites; it cannot be the work of a Muslim' — this is the warning given through the first words of this hadith.
(Badhl al-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسِ نِ الْجُهَنِيِّ ﵁ عَنْ اَبِيْهِ قَالَ: غَزَوْتُ مَعَ نَبِيِّ اللهِ
